subject_definitions:
  图片 1: 角色参考图之一，同一角色，面部五官、发型、瞳色、表情等样貌细节以此图为准。
  图片 2: 角色参考图之二，同一角色，身材比例、服装款式、配色、配饰、鞋履等设定细节以此图为准。
  以上所有参考图为同一角色，全片角色的画风、面部特征、发型、身材比例、服装、配饰必须与参考图严格一致，不新增、不替换参考图中已明确呈现的任何设定元素。

summary:
  2秒 9:16 竖屏，纯色浅灰背景，均匀打光。以 subject_definitions 中参考图的角色为唯一主角，四个镜头各0.5秒，以硬切（直接跳切、无任何转场渐变）依次呈现该角色的人脸特写、正面全身、侧面全身、背面全身，构成标准角色设定四视图。每个镜头内角色完全静止、呈直立设定姿势（A-pose式自然站姿）、相机锁死，无推拉升降、无运动模糊。全片画风、线条、上色方式与参考图完全一致。

retention_analysis:
  subject_definitions 中全部参考图共同锁定角色设定：人脸参考决定五官画法、发型与瞳色，是全片一致性锚点；含全身的参考决定头身比、服装版型与配色方案；侧面参考决定发型层次与身体轮廓。参考图中未覆盖的视角与部位（如未提供背面参考时的发型后侧、服装背部印花与结构），由模型基于已提供参考图的同一角色设定合理推断补齐，推断结果必须与已提供参考图在画风、配色、服装结构上自洽，不得引入与参考图冲突的新设定。

detailed_description:
  0-0.5s: 人脸特写。构图取胸部以上，角色面部正对镜头，五官、发型、瞳色、表情严格以参考图为准；眼神正视；机位正面平拍、固定不动；浅灰纯色背景；画面完全静止，无任何运动。
  0.5-1.0s: 硬切至正面全身。角色全身入画，直立设定姿势、双臂自然下垂或按参考图姿态，全身服装、配色、配饰、鞋履严格以参考图为准；机位正面、全身竖构图、固定不动；浅灰纯色背景；画面完全静止。
  1.0-1.5s: 硬切至侧面全身。角色侧身90度直立，发型层次、身体轮廓、服装侧面结构严格以参考图为准；机位侧向、全身竖构图、固定不动；浅灰纯色背景；画面完全静止。
  1.5-2.0s: 硬切至背面全身。角色背对镜头直立，发型后侧、服装背部结构以参考图为准并与其余视角自洽；机位背面、全身竖构图、固定不动；浅灰纯色背景；画面完全静止至结束。

overall_soundscape:
  每次硬切瞬间一声清脆的电子提示音（共4次）；极轻的空间底噪；无对白、无人声、无环境杂音。

non_diegetic_music:
  极简电子氛围，C大调，60 BPM，无人声，音量极低近乎垫底，2秒结尾处干净淡出收束。

negative_constraints:
  禁止镜头推拉摇移；禁止角色动作、眨眼外的任何运动；禁止运动模糊；禁止转场渐变、淡入淡出、叠化；禁止四视图之间的旋转过渡动画；禁止写实化、真人化渲染（参考图为动漫/CG画风时必须保持原画风，不得漂移为写实照片质感）；禁止2D与3D风格混用；禁止改变参考图中角色的头身比、发型、瞳色、服装与配饰；禁止多余肢体、手指数量错误；禁止画面崩坏、五官错位。

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the single person whose facial features, hairstyle, skin tone, and makeup come from <Picture 1>, supplemented by <Picture 3>, <Picture 4>, <Picture 5>, and <Picture 6>, and whose body proportions, full outfit, accessories, and footwear come strictly and exclusively from <Picture 2>. All six pictures show the same person. Across the whole video, the face and hairstyle must strictly follow <Picture 1> and its supplements, and the body and outfit must strictly and exclusively follow <Picture 2>; no element shown in the references may be added, removed, or swapped.

summary:
[reference generation] A 2-second 9:16 vertical video on a plain light-grey studio background with soft, even lighting. <Subject 1> is the sole subject, presented in exactly four static shots of 0.5 seconds each, connected by hard cuts with no transitions: a chest-up portrait, a front full-body view, a 90-degree side full-body view, and a back full-body view, forming a standard four-view character sheet. In every shot the subject is already in the final pose from the first frame and stays completely still; the camera is locked off; there is no motion blur. All four shots share one identical outfit from <Picture 2>. No shot may be omitted or merged.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - facial features, hairstyle, skin tone, and makeup strictly follow <Picture 1> with <Picture 3>, <Picture 4>, <Picture 5>, and <Picture 6> as supplements; body proportions, outfit, accessories, and footwear strictly and exclusively follow <Picture 2> in all four shots, including the collar and shoulders visible in [Shot 1]. Angles and body parts not covered by the references are completed consistently with the provided references in style, color, material, and build, with no conflicting new elements.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a clean, sharp portrait-photography look with accurate color, soft even studio lighting, and a plain light-grey background.
[Shot 1] A static chest-up portrait of <Subject 1>. From the first frame, <Subject 1> already faces the camera and stays completely still. The face is centered horizontally and vertically; the head from hair to chin occupies about 45% of the frame height, with slight headroom above the hair. The frame includes the full hair, both ears, the complete face, the neck, and the upper chest, ending above mid-chest with the collar and shoulders visible and matching the outfit from <Picture 2>. The eyes look into the lens. Locked-off front camera at eye level. No movement at all.
[Shot 2] At 00:00.500, the shot hard-cuts to a front full-body view of <Subject 1>. From the first frame, <Subject 1> already stands upright facing the camera with arms hanging naturally, completely still, with no turning or transition motion. The full body is centered; the body height occupies about 85% of the frame height, leaving about 7% of frame height above the head and 7% below the soles, with the head and feet fully inside the frame. Body, outfit, accessories, and footwear strictly and exclusively follow <Picture 2>. Locked-off front camera. Completely static.
[Shot 3] At 00:01.000, the shot hard-cuts to a 90-degree side full-body view of <Subject 1>. From the first frame, <Subject 1> already stands in a perfect side profile with arms hanging naturally, completely still, with no turning process. Same framing as Shot 2: body height about 85% of the frame height, head and soles fully inside the frame with margins. The side profile and hairstyle follow <Picture 1>; body and outfit strictly and exclusively follow <Picture 2>. Locked-off side camera. Completely static.
[Shot 4] At 00:01.500, the shot hard-cuts to a back full-body view of <Subject 1>. From the first frame, <Subject 1> already stands with the back to the camera, arms hanging naturally, completely still, with no turning process. Same framing as Shot 2: the full body inside the frame with margins. The back of the hairstyle follows <Picture 1>; the outfit's back details strictly and exclusively follow <Picture 2>, completed consistently with the other views. Locked-off back camera. Completely static until the end.

overall_soundscape:
A crisp camera shutter click at each of the four hard cuts; extremely quiet studio room tone throughout; no dialogue, no vocals.

non_diegetic_music:
Minimal ambient electronic in C major at 60 BPM, no vocals, extremely low volume, with a clean fade-out at the end.

negative_constraints:
No shot may be omitted or merged; all four shots must appear independently. No camera push, pull, pan, or tilt; no subject motion except blinking; no pose change within a shot; no turning, rotating, or walking transitions between shots — after each hard cut the subject is already in the final pose. No cropping of the head, hair, face, or feet in any shot; in full-body shots the head must never leave the frame and the body height must not exceed 90% of the frame height; in [Shot 1] the face must stay centered and fully inside the frame, never half-cropped, and the frame must not extend below mid-chest. No motion blur; no fades or dissolves; no rotation animations between views; no outfit inconsistency across the four shots; no AI-smoothed skin, beauty-filter look, plastic texture, CG-render look, or uncanny-valley effect; no change to the subject's gender traits, age, facial features, outfit, or accessories from the references.

summary:

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1>（出现于 [Shot 1]、[Shot 2]、[Shot 3]、[Shot 4]）：partially_preserved —— 物种、面部五官、耳形、毛色与斑纹完全保留自 <Picture 1>，是全片身份锚点；体型比例、躯干四肢结构与尾巴形态以 <Picture 2> 为准；服装为来自 <Picture 2> 的 attribute_transfer：<Picture 2> 中的服装被 <Subject 1> 原样穿着于所有镜头，并覆盖参考中未着装的外观呈现。参考未覆盖的视角与部位（背部斑纹、尾部后侧、服装背面细节）基于同一体与同一套服装合理推断，符合该物种真实解剖结构，并与参考图在毛色、斑纹走向、体型、材质上自洽，不引入冲突新元素。
